Insurance

Atténuation du risque

A set of strategies, measures, or controls used by insurers and reinsurers to reduce the likelihood, impact, or severity of insured or operational risks. This includes underwriting, reinsurance, diversification, and loss prevention programs.

Questions and answers

What is Atténuation du risque?

In this glossary, Atténuation du risque refers to: A set of strategies, measures, or controls used by insurers and reinsurers to reduce the likelihood, impact, or severity of insured or operational risks. This includes underwriting, reinsurance, diversification, and loss prevention programs.

How is Atténuation du risque used in finance?

In finance communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Les assureurs mettent en œuvre des stratégies d’atténuation du risque telles que la réassurance et la diversification de portefeuille pour gérer les expositions globales."

Definition

A set of strategies, measures, or controls used by insurers and reinsurers to reduce the likelihood, impact, or severity of insured or operational risks. This includes underwriting, reinsurance, diversification, and loss prevention programs.

Operational example

Insurers implement risk mitigation strategies such as reinsurance and portfolio diversification to manage aggregate exposures.

Localized term

Atténuation du risque

Localized example

Les assureurs mettent en œuvre des stratégies d’atténuation du risque telles que la réassurance et la diversification de portefeuille pour gérer les expositions globales.
